prompt_text: I want to try a tanning salon in Columbus. Which specific salons should I call, and why?
q1_prompt_text: What is the best tanning salon in Columbus OH?
answer_verbatim:
I can do that — first I need two quick details so I give accurate, useful picks:

1) Which Columbus do you mean (Columbus, OH; Columbus, GA; Columbus, IN; etc.)?  
2) Do you want a UV tanning bed/tower (traditional tanning) or a sunless/spray tan?

If you aren’t sure, tell me your zip code or neighborhood and whether you prefer UV or spray, and I’ll return 4–6 specific salons to call with short reasons for each.

While you decide, here’s a checklist of what to ask when you call and why each item matters (so you can compare salons quickly):

- Do you offer UV tanning, spray tanning, or both? (Confirms they provide the service you want.)  
- What type/brand of spray tan system and solution do you use? (Look for reputable systems like Mystic/Versa/BronzExpress and DHA-based solutions; ask about hypoallergenic or organic options if you have sensitive skin.)  
- Are your spray techs certified and can I see before/after photos or reviews? (Experience affects evenness and color.)  
- What levels/brands of tanning beds do you have (low/medium/high pressure, stand-up vs. lay-down)? (Different beds produce different results and expose you to different UV intensities.)  
- How often are the beds and booths cleaned/maintained? (Hygiene and bulb maintenance affect safety and results.)  
- Do you require a patch test for spray tans or have restrictions for UV tanning (medications, skin type)? (Safety — some meds make you photosensitive.)  
- Do you offer first-time specials, packages or memberships? (Cost savings.)  
- What are your appointment/cancellation policies and typical wait times? (Convenience.)  
- Can you recommend a pre- and post-tan routine (exfoliation, moisturizers, shower timing)? (Helps longevity and evenness of tan.)  
- Are goggles provided for UV tanning? (Eye protection is required.)  
- Do you follow local/state sanitation and licensing rules? (Assures legitimacy.)

If you want, I can also include a short phone script you can use when calling each salon. Tell me which Columbus and your spray vs. UV choice and I’ll pull a targeted list.
